captions: The market at dusk. Your thumb on the mic. Note 10.
“You won't believe what Sara did at the wedding…”
Then, at the spice stall: Sara. She sees you first.
She smiles. Buys you mint tea. Asks about your mum.
The tea is warm. Your phone feels heavy.
After Isha, on the roof. You open the chat.
Delete for everyone. One. Two. All nine.
Then a new message to Sara: “Thank you for the tea.”
Below, the city is quiet. So, finally, are you.

post.caption:
9 voice notes about her today. Allah heard all 9. 🤍

The people we talk about are often the ones who'd buy us tea. Guard your tongue before it costs you.

“Indeed, prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing.” (29:45)

Tonight, before you sleep: delete them. Say one good thing about her.
